hooks.name: publish-guard
hooks.description: Keep internal research material, internal handover documents and API keys out of the public repository. Switch to a command action running `npm run --silent check:repo` once that script exists (data-contract tasks).

action.prompt: This file looks like internal material that must not be in the public repository: deep-research reports, review packets, extracted research rows, run logs, verification ledgers, the research kit guide or the internal handover documents (they contain team member names and article excerpts), or a secrets file. Do not commit it. Tell the user which file it is and ask them to move it outside the repository. If it is a .env file, make sure .gitignore covers it and that no API key (for example a 국가법령정보센터 OC value or a Congress.gov api_key) appears in tracked files.
